What we do( products · experiences · beyond )

Product design is our core. A good design problem can take us anywhere.

We shape digital products end to end—from research and product strategy to UX, interaction, visual design and build support.

When a brief stretches into an object, vehicle, sculpture, retail space or something without a tidy label, we bring the same curiosity, systems thinking and craft.

Why rabbitsfoot ( wider lens · senior team · shared ownership )

Four disciplines. One senior team. No hand-offs in thinking.

We are senior designers shaped by operational software, healthcare, defence, mobility and connected products. Product, experience, industrial and spatial perspectives sit at the same table—so each problem is seen from more than one angle before a direction is chosen.

You work directly with the people doing the work. The same team questions the brief, shapes the system and stays through the final detail, using whatever tools serve the work—including AI—without outsourcing judgment or responsibility.

01 / Range

Different disciplines, shared table.

Each specialist sees a different risk, behavior or possibility. Together, we see more of the whole problem—not just the expected deliverable.

02 / Seniority

The people you meet do the work.

No pitch team followed by a hand-off. The people who shape the direction stay close enough to carry its intent into every decision.

03 / Ownership

We stay for the difficult bit.

From the first question to the final state, detail or hand-off, we stay accountable for making the whole experience clear, useful and resolved.

How the work moves

Close to the problem.
Closer to the people.

01Observe

Go where the work is.

Watch the hand-offs, workarounds and pressure points. The real environment becomes the brief.

02Make

Give the idea weight.

Prototype early enough to expose the wrong assumptions while changing them is still cheap.

03Stress

Test the ugly moments.

Gloves on. Alarm sounding. Network gone. Design for the moment the polished demo never shows.

04Ship

Stay until it is real.

Work beside engineering, protect the intent and tune the product through the final mile.

How we're put together( senior only )

Seven specialists who can follow an idea from screen to street to shelf.

Product, marketing, art direction, industrial design, spatial experience, technology and strategy sit at the same table.

We stay deliberately small. It is how senior hands remain on every interface, object and environment that ships.

01Access

How to start ( 30 minutes · no deck )
01

Book a call

Thirty minutes with the people who would do the work. We will start with the problem, the people and what a good outcome looks like.

02

Or just write

Tell us what you are making, changing or still trying to figure out. A few honest lines are enough to start.

03

What happens next

A short written response with what we think the real problem is, how we would scope it, and whether we are the right studio for it.

  • Reply within one working day
  • Scope and shape in under a week
  • No pitch theatre, ever
Good fit
  • A new or evolving digital product
  • A journey or service with too much friction
  • A complex system that needs clarity
  • A design brief that resists a neat label
What matters
  • A real problem, not a predetermined output
  • Access to the people and the context
  • Room to question the first assumption
  • Enough time and care to do the work properly
